text:
anya: Quick sync — we need a concise GA gate for the next Private-tier rollout. Focus: SLA, obs, docs, support coverage, and pricing commitments. How do we prioritize the outstanding customer asks vs. minimal GA bar?
sam: +1. can we list the hard blockers? I think capacity autoscale and single-tenant network tests are top.
lee: From SRE: paging/runbooks for P1 & P2, and latency SLO dashboards need to exist. Also require a postmortem runbook template in the console.
dave: Commercial: customers asking for 99.9% for ded. pools. We need clear pricing tiers: reserved vs burst. If we promise 99.9 we need capacity commits or penalties — need legal input.
maya: Docs check: API example for private deployment, onboarding checklist, and an admin runbook. Also localizing error messages for EU customers.
an: List of proposed GA acceptance criteria (minimal):
- SLA: documented SLO with measurement method and stated refund policy (if any)
- Observability: latency + error dashboards, alert rules, and runbook links
- Support: oncall rota assigned, escalation path, support SLA tiers published
- Docs: quickstart, admin-runbook, billing/FAQ updates
- Pricing: clear reserved vs burst pricing + trial credit flow
Can we commit owners/dates?
sam: I'll own autoscale + perf validation. ETA EOD Wed. Will add test matrix to the console.
lee: I'll own alerts/runbooks. Need one week for runbook drafts. Also request: add PromQL alert we can use as baseline:
```
alert: PrivateDeploymentHighErrorRate
expr: sum(increase(private_request_errors_total[5m])) / sum(increase(private_request_total[5m])) > 0.005
for: 5m
```
lee: Also want a smoke query for 95th latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`
dave: I'll draft pricing language with options: (1) Reserved monthly + discount, (2) On-demand with burst credits. Need numbers from infra cost model by Fri.
maya: I'll start doc templates today. Can someone paste any customer wording we promised? I want accurate copy.
anya: Customer asks (from tracker): 
- ACME: dedicated region + data residency + 99.9 SLA
- BrightAI: face heavy tail SLOs, wants 0-backfill during bursts
- FinCo: requires contract wording for refunds/credits
anya: Proposal for prioritization: must-have for GA = ACME + FinCo blocks (SLA + legal + billing + docs). BrightAI asks can be post-GA but flagged as high. Thoughts?
sam: agree. BrightAI is complex (workload engineering). Can be pilot program after GA.
dave: agree with prioritization, but we must surface cost delta for ACME vs standard customers. I'll add cost slides.
lee: one more ops ask: we need canary rollout plan + automated fallback in router. I'll add a minimal routing policy to the rollout playbook.
anya: Actions and owners:
- sam: autoscale perf tests + matrix (due Wed EOD)
- lee: alerts + runbook + canary rollout doc (due next Tue)
- dave: pricing wording + cost delta (due Fri)
- maya: docs templates + customer copy (due Thu)
- anya: consolidate GA acceptance doc and send to gatekeepers by Fri
anya: If no objections I'll lock this prioritization and start gating work. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: automated note: created ticket INFRA-2145 for autoscale perf tests (assignee: sam).
maya: :eyes: will sync on copy before Thu.
dave: :thumbsup:
sam: got it, will update ticket with matrix and a small perf run plan.
lee: acknowledged, will post runbook draft in #eng-oncall when ready.
anya: Thanks — wrapping up. I'll post the consolidated acceptance doc after lunch and tag gatekeepers.
